name: How do I budget and finance my home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I budget and finance my home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Create a detailed budget including a contingency fund of 10-20%. Consider financing options such as home equity loans or personal loans and prioritize projects to align with your budget and goals.
